cohort: This study analyzed labour outcomes in 200 women who presented with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) at 37 completed weeks of gestation or later.
finding: In term PROM cases, 9% experienced maternal complications (most commonly puerperal pyrexia and wound infection, occurring more frequently when PROM duration was greater than 24 hours), and 20% of infants required NICU admission, with 6.5% neonatal deaths, primarily due to RDS following septicemia.
gest_age: Term (≥ 37 completed weeks), with most cases occurring between 38-39 weeks.
